label: Dreischulte 76: Full blood count more than 24 weeks ago during cyclophosphamide treatment
title: Full blood count more than 24 weeks ago during cyclophosphamide treatment
statement: Patient treated with cyclophosphamide - had no FBC check in the last 24 weeks

plain_summary: The 2012 criterion flags a gap of more than 24 weeks since the last full blood count during treatment with cyclophosphamide.

needs_facts.what: Timing of the latest completed full blood count (24-week window)
needs_facts.meets: The latest completed full blood count was more than 168 days before the latest qualifying supply, or no completed test was found after checking for tests done elsewhere.

options.words: Completed on or within 168 days before the latest qualifying supply
Latest completed test was more than 168 days before the latest qualifying supply
No completed full blood count was found after checking for tests done elsewhere

rule_for_models: Start at the latest Group A cyclophosphamide supply regardless of indication. Give no finding if a completed full blood count was collected on that date or in the preceding 168 days (24 weeks), using the test collection date rather than a later note date. A shorter course alone does not rule out this finding. A timing answer that confirms a completed test in this window also rules out a finding. Report a finding if the record confirms that the latest completed test was more than 168 days before this supply, or that no completed test was found after checking for tests done elsewhere. Cite the latest Group A supply and the line that gives the date of the latest completed full blood count or confirms the monitoring gap for this supply. If timing for this supply is missing, unknown or only established for a different supply date, report only a possible finding. Cite the latest Group A supply and name "Timing of the latest completed full blood count (24-week window)" as the missing fact.
cannot_be_seen: A pharmacy record can omit tests done elsewhere. An old report alone cannot establish the latest test date. A test order does not show that blood was collected.
ask_the_gp: Could we confirm the latest completed full blood count and review the monitoring interval appropriate for this person's cyclophosphamide treatment?
